extracted.intended_audience: professional journalists and media professionals (plus general public visitors to Pfizer's newsroom)
extracted.subtask_description: Pfizer newsroom page listing press releases, media assets, updates/statements, and media contact instructions; intended to guide media professionals on where to find assets and how to request information. Includes procedural requirements for media inquiries and subscription to Pfizer Wire.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press releases organized by date and category
rubrics_metrics.description: All Pfizer published press releases by date and/or category of news
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases are presented with date and category labels (examples shown: Prescription Medicines, Corporate, Financial) and paginated (Page 1, Page 2, ...).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Asset Library (assets available for media use)
rubrics_metrics.description: A collection of assets for use by media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available assets enumerated include: Logos, Photography, Videos and B-roll, Fact Sheets. Use these resources when preparing coverage or requesting materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updates and Statements section for timely announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Updates and Statements lists recent company updates and statements (examples: CHMP opinion, foundation grants).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points users to 'View All Updates and Statements' for additional context and official company positions or announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contacts respond only to professional journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: Pfizer media contacts may only respond to calls and emails from professional journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact options are provided (general email, international email, U.S. phone number). This is an eligibility rule: only professional journalists should expect responses from Pfizer Media Relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information required for media inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: To best help us help you, please be prepared to provide your name and email address, a summary of the article you're working on and your deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When contacting media relations, include: your full name, email address, an article summary, and your deadline to facilitate timely assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use press releases, statements, and press kits to stay current
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage everyone to view our press releases, press statements, and press kits to stay up to date on Pfizer news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Journalists and other stakeholders should consult these official materials as primary sources for company news and background information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to Pfizer Wire for real-time news updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Stay up to date on the latest news and alerts through the Pfizer Wire. Sign up to receive real-time updates on Pfizer’s news from the Pfizer Media Relations team delivered directly to your inbox.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Pfizer Wire subscription to receive immediate notifications of press releases and statements; this is the recommended channel for timely alerts.
